title: Gumley
html_source: Gumley is still asleep on the job. Appropriately “guarding” stones – Bloom thinks this is appropriate since Gumley is one of Parnell’s followers and legend has it that Parnell is not dead and that his coffin is filled with stones. He also thinks that Parnell was metaphorically “stoned to death” by his followers. We first hear of Gumley in Chapter 7 “Aeolus” and there is a more detailed note on that page.
